name: Meld
description: The same hand-over in every cell, running the other way in every other one.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: var(--color1); :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @p(var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: linear-gradient(180deg, #000 0%, transparent 100%); mask: linear-gradient(180deg, #000 0%, transparent 100%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } @even { -webkit-transform: rotate(180deg); transform: rotate(180deg); } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
